meeting.summary: Director of Administrative Services Kimberly Ruesch reviewed the FY2026 revenue picture — YTD budget amendments through the 4th amendment, revenues vs. expenditures by fund, General Fund revenue by major type, and revenue assumptions. Council discussed additional funding options: Recreation/Arts/Parks (RAP) Tax, Library Tax, Transportation Utility Fund (TUF), and Municipal Energy Tax (MET). Council then adjourned to and returned from closed session before adjourning the meeting.
